Derived from real Encounters; no second database, persistence schema or synthetic score authority.

owners.notes: Normalizes portable Flow intent and resolves effective step metric/execution semantics. It cannot write persistence or create Active/Session/Encounter facts.

Builds detached immutable Flow/step context semantics. Runtime integration may attach equivalent provenance only at the existing app.js Encounter commit boundary; this helper is not an Encounter writer and does not replace metricSchemaSnapshot or executionModeSnapshot authority.

owners.delegatesTo: canonical Object selection + existing recorder + existing Active lifecycle + existing app.js Encounter/session writers + v61 classic set owner
owners.notes: Phase 2 stores durable Flow definitions and one reload-safe current run context inside the existing app-owned state. It owns intent continuity only, never training facts. Temporary schema/execution context is restricted to the current recording handoff; Object Truth/history/Evolution remain canonical.
Optional large-control mobile interaction experiment. Must be removable with zero effect on training facts, navigation, execution semantics or 8.21 release success.

rules: One semantic action has one interactive writer.
One current training fact has one authoritative store.
Compatibility bridges delegate; they do not regain authority.
A derived projection or resolver cannot create a second persistence model.
Flow intent may extend the established app-owned axis_v60_state but cannot become Encounter fact authority.
Temporary Flow recording context may affect only the current recording handoff and may not mutate reusable Object truth.
Classic repeated-set facts remain v61-owned even when a Flow selects the Object.
Changing an owner requires explicit handoff, regression proof, and retirement of the previous writer.
